Advanced machine learning algorithms such as random forest, gradient boosting, and deep neural network are used for this purpose. The essential factors/drivers for each sector are derived through the explainable artificial intelligence Shapley framework, which scientifically measures the contribution of each factor to energy consumption. Consequently, the major key indicators for each of the four sectors under consideration are identified. Alternatively, the insights gained from the study may prompt a complete switch to alternative energy-efficient sources. The study findings provide valuable insights for both communities and businesses in achieving the goals of net-zero and energy conservation. Additionally, some examples are highlighted to demonstrate how practitioners can implement customized designs under each sector to reduce harmful emissions and promote energy efficiency. Suitable steps for stakeholder engagement and community participation in this regard are also suggested.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在优化能源消耗以实现可持续性，因为有必要通过转向净零碳排放燃料替代品来进军绿色能源市场。需要决定何时从传统能源转向这些净零燃料，这要求更深入地调查导致有害能源排放的驱动因素。这项调查将有助于监测和遏制此类指标，以最大限度地减少有害排放，或者在指标水平无法控制时确定转向绿色能源替代品的适当时机。本研究的动机源于近期研究，这些研究考虑了人均碳强度以及部门特定因素，如每户碳强度和每增加值碳强度。然而，这些研究并未科学量化每个要素对最终传统能源消耗的贡献程度。此外，还需要估算部门特定的消耗指标，以进行开发节能系统的重大设计修改。对于所考虑的四个部门（住宅、工业、服务业和交通运输），消耗被预测为“总消耗”。为此，使用了先进的机器学习算法，如随机森林、梯度提升和深度神经网络。通过可解释的人工智能Shapley框架得出每个部门的基本因素/驱动因素，该框架科学地衡量了每个因素对能源消耗的贡献。因此，确定了所考虑的四个部门中的每一个的主要关键指标。或者，从研究中获得的见解可能促使完全转向替代节能能源。研究结果为社区和企业实现净零和节能目标提供了宝贵的见解。此外，还强调了一些示例，以展示从业者如何在每个部门下实施定制设计以减少有害排放并促进能源效率。还提出了利益相关者参与和社区参与此事的适当步骤。

articles.title_en: Energy sustainability under the COVID-19 outbreak: Electricity break-off policy to minimize electricity market crises
articles.title_cn: COVID-19疫情下的能源可持续性：电力中断政策以最小化电力市场危机
articles.abstract_en: The world is still facing great economic challenges due to COVID-19, which has significantly influenced energy consumption. While national lockdown policies have been adopted to prevent further outbreaks of the virus, this has hindered electricity supply to manufacturing industries and households. This research optimizes electricity consumption behavior by introducing an electricity break-off (EBO) policy using simulation-based optimization. We measure the optimal time to provide electricity in manufacturing industries and household communities and also calculate the optimal incentive rate on electricity shortfall to minimize electricity crises in the EBO policy. Using this EBO policy, manufacturing industries can run their systems for a limited time under optimal electricity consumption. It is expected that the proposed energy consumption strategy will help sustain environmental quality due to optimal emissions and assist policymakers in conserving energy resources. Conserved energy resources are vital for tackling emerging challenges in the future that could potentially be similar to the ongoing COVID-19 outbreak.
articles.abstract_cn: 世界仍因COVID-19面临巨大经济挑战，这显著影响了能源消耗。虽然国家封锁政策已被采纳以防止病毒进一步爆发，但这阻碍了制造业和家庭的电力供应。本研究通过引入基于模拟优化的电力中断（EBO）政策来优化电力消耗行为。我们测量了制造业和家庭社区提供电力的最优时间，并计算了电力短缺的最优激励率，以在EBO政策下最小化电力危机。使用该EBO政策，制造业可以在最优电力消耗下有限时间内运行其系统。预计所提出的能源消耗策略将有助于通过最优排放维持环境质量，并协助政策制定者节约能源资源。节约的能源资源对于应对未来可能类似于当前COVID-19疫情的挑战至关重要。

articles.title_en: Dynamic optimization of carbon capture technology deployment targeting carbon neutrality, cost efficiency and water stress: Evidence from China's electric power sector
articles.title_cn: 以碳中和、成本效率和水资源压力为目标的碳捕集技术部署的动态优化：来自中国电力行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: The potential of carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) has been widely discussed worldwide, while the dynamic changing process, lock-in risk and water resource constraints towards carbon neutrality target are not fully considered in the previous studies. This study developed a comprehensive approach to optimize carbon mitigation potential, total capital expenditure and water resource stress for China's coal-fired power plants (CFPPs) with CCUS retrofitting in a dynamic environment. We found that the annual capture scale will start to increase significantly until 2030 and reach 2.4 billion tons CO2 in 2050. The newly-added capture scale of first-generation technology will decline gradually after 2030 due to the breakthrough in second-generation technology. Inner Mongolia, Jiangsu and Guangdong have the greatest potential for implementing CCUS projects, and the least in Hainan, Sichuan and Qinghai. The annual capture cost roughly presents an "inverted U" shape with the peaking (14.70 billion CNY) occurring in 2035, while the annual R&D investment can be observed a moderate "N" shape with the peaking (11.24 billion CNY) occurring in 2030. The annual non-corporate expenditures (subsidy) will picture a significant "inverted U" type trend, peaking at 63.71 billion CNY in 2044 as a result of the risk factors such as CCUS facility investment and additional storage cost caused by uncertain geological conditions. In addition, the annual water withdrawal and consumption of capture process will increase from 0.09 and 0.06 billion m3 respectively in 2021 to 9.12 and 6.22 billion m3 respectively in 2050, while CO2-EWR (Enhanced water recovery) process will make CCUS technology supply extra water resource since 2035, reaching 27.05 billion m3 in 2050. Meanwhile, in terms of first- and second-generation capture technology, the unit water withdrawal will drop 35.04% and 36.71%, respectively, while the unit water consumption will drop 66.89% and 74.12%, respectively during 2021–2050. Overall, although CCUS will not intensify water resource stress in the future, the appropriate relaxation ratio of water quota is essential at the initial stage.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳捕获、利用和封存（CCUS）的潜力已在世界范围内得到广泛讨论，但以往的研究并未充分考虑碳中和目标的动态变化过程、锁定风险和水资源约束。本研究开发了一种综合方法，以在动态环境中优化中国燃煤电厂 (CFPP) 的碳减排潜力、总资本支出和水资源压力，并进行 CCUS 改造。我们发现，每年的捕集规模将开始显着增加，直到2030，并在2050达到2.4十亿吨CO2。由于二代技术的突破，第一代技术新增捕获规模将在2030之后逐渐下降。内蒙古、江苏和广东地区CCUS项目实施潜力最大，海南、四川和青海潜力最小。年度捕集成本大致呈“倒U”形，峰值（14.70亿元）出现在2035，而年度研发投入可观察到适度的“N”形，峰值（11.24亿元）出现在2030。受CCUS设施投资、地质条件不确定导致的额外封存成本等风险因素影响，年度非企业支出（补贴）将呈现显着的“倒U”型走势，预计在2044年达到63.71亿元的峰值。此外，每年捕集过程的取水量和消耗量将从2021的0.09和0.06亿m3分别增加到2050的9.12和6.22亿m3，而CO2-EWR（增强水回收）过程将使CCUS技术提供额外的水资源。 2035，在2050达到27.05十亿m3。同时，就第一代和第二代捕集技术而言，2021-2050期间单位取水量将分别下降35.04%和36.71%，单位用水量将分别下降66.89%和74.12%。总体而言，虽然CCUS未来不会加剧水资源压力，但初期适当放宽用水配额比例至关重要。

articles.title_en: Financial stress and commodity price volatility
articles.title_cn: 金融压力与大宗商品价格波动
articles.abstract_en: We use a Markov-switching vector autoregressive model to examine the impact of financial stress on the volatility of commodity prices, including energy volatility. An increase in financial stress leads to a persistent increase in the volatility of the commodity index and of individual commodity prices. We confirm the existence of three volatility regimes, with the volatility of the commodity index and of individual commodity prices in the high volatility regime being more than 25 times larger than that in other regimes. A financial stress shock that arrives during a highly volatile period has more destabilizing and persistent effects than when the shock arrives during a low volatility period. The impact on energy volatility in the high volatility regime is over 60% larger than that on the volatility of the commodity index. The high volatility regime is short-lived and reflects major economic events as well as the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用马尔可夫区制转换向量自回归模型来考察金融压力对大宗商品价格波动（包括能源波动）的影响。金融压力的增加会导致大宗商品指数和个别大宗商品价格的波动持续增加。我们确认存在三种波动区制，其中高波动区制下的大宗商品指数和个别大宗商品价格的波动是其他区制的25倍以上。在高波动时期到来的金融压力冲击比在低波动时期到来的冲击具有更强的破坏性和持续性影响。在高波动区制下，对能源波动的影响比对大宗商品指数波动的影响大60%以上。高波动区制持续时间短，反映了重大经济事件以及COVID-19疫情的爆发。

articles.title_en: Exploring the critical demand drivers of electricity consumption in Thailand
articles.title_cn: 探索泰国电力消费的关键需求驱动因素
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we explore the critical demand drivers of electricity consumption in Thailand based on monthly data from 2002 to 2020. Using Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL), cross-quantile correlation (CQC), Generalized Method of Moments (GMM), and Granger-causality-in-quantile approaches, we find that industrial production and oil production positively contribute to next month's aggregate and provincial energy consumption in Thailand, both in the short and long run. We also find that industrial production positively affects current electricity consumption, whereas electricity prices negatively affect current electricity consumption. Oil production, however, has no effect on current electricity consumption. Moreover, the CQC analysis finds evidence of cross-predictability running from industrial production and electricity prices to next month's electricity consumption at the extreme and median quantiles of the distribution. Further, industrial production, electricity prices, and oil production Granger-cause energy consumption at the extreme and median quantiles of the distribution. Nevertheless, we show that the Thai government's energy policies are ineffective for reducing electricity consumption. Our findings have crucial policy implications for the electricity market efficient allocation and its reform.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们基于2002年至2020年的月度数据，探索了泰国电力消费的关键需求驱动因素。使用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）、交叉分位数相关（CQC）、广义矩估计（GMM）和分位数格兰杰因果方法，我们发现工业生产和石油生产对泰国下个月的总体和省级能源消费有正向贡献，无论是在短期还是长期。我们还发现，工业生产对当前电力消费有正向影响，而电价对当前电力消费有负向影响。然而，石油生产对当前电力消费没有影响。此外，CQC分析发现，在分布的极端和中间分位数上，工业生产和电价对下个月电力消费存在交叉可预测性。进一步，工业生产、电价和石油生产在分布的极端和中间分位数上格兰杰导致能源消费。然而，我们表明泰国政府的能源政策在减少电力消费方面无效。我们的发现对电力市场的有效配置及其改革具有重要的政策含义。

articles.title_en: Is there a macroeconomic carbon rebound effect in EU ETS?
articles.title_cn: 欧盟碳排放交易体系中是否存在宏观经济碳回弹效应？
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the macroeconomic carbon rebound effect for the European Union (EU) Emissions Trading System (ETS) by using data for the 2005–2019 period for 26 European countries. We estimate the panel data models which link emissions to allowances by controlling for economic growth, investment, employment, and energy intensity. The results from both the recent panel estimation approaches and Granger causality analysis indicate a macroeconomic carbon rebound effect of the EU ETS. The bidirectional Granger causality between emissions and allowances highlights a self-enforcing macroeconomic rebound. Energy intensity significantly impacts emissions directly and indirectly via the macroeconomic rebound effect. Our results show that positive economic spillovers of ETSs may hamper the efforts to meet climate targets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用2005-2019年期间26个欧洲国家的数据，考察了欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）的宏观经济碳回弹效应。我们通过控制经济增长、投资、就业和能源强度，估计了将排放与配额联系起来的面板数据模型。来自近期面板估计方法和格兰杰因果分析的结果均表明，欧盟排放交易体系存在宏观经济碳回弹效应。排放与配额之间的双向格兰杰因果关系凸显了一种自我强化的宏观经济回弹。能源强度通过宏观经济回弹效应直接和间接地显著影响排放。我们的结果表明，排放交易体系的积极经济溢出效应可能会阻碍实现气候目标的努力。

articles.title_en: How Fintech and effective governance derive the greener energy transition: Evidence from panel-corrected standard errors approach
articles.title_cn: 金融科技与有效治理如何推动更绿色的能源转型：基于面板校正标准误方法的证据
articles.abstract_en: Over the past few years, energy transition is emerging and debatable concern for economies especially targeting net zero carbon emissions. Despite of huge literature on energy transition, still limited studies have taken in account the role of fintech and government effectiveness in altering energy transition. This study valuably adds to empirical literature by examining the role of fintech and government effectiveness in energy transition. To fulfil this purpose, panel data of 91 middle income countries has been taken in paper that ranges from 2000 to 2020. The study is based on Driscoll and Kraay's approach of Panel Corrected Standard Error. The computed outcomes reported that fintech positively determines middle-income countries' energy transition. Also the study revealed that government effectiveness plays a constructive role in the energy transition to renewable energy sources. Furthermore, the analysis also confirmed the significant potential role of economic growth, industry value added, urbanization, and foreign direct investment in the energy transition in the selected sample. The study analysis sets down the practical implication in formulating energy transition policies for policymakers and to target net zero carbon emissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去几年中，能源转型正成为经济体尤其是以净零碳排放为目标的经济体新兴且备受争议的关注点。尽管关于能源转型的文献众多，但考虑金融科技和政府效能对改变能源转型作用的有限研究仍然较少。本研究通过考察金融科技和政府效能在能源转型中的作用，为实证文献增添了宝贵价值。为实现这一目的，本文选取了91个中等收入国家的面板数据，时间跨度为2000年至2020年。研究基于Driscoll和Kraay的面板校正标准误方法。计算结果显示，金融科技对中等收入国家的能源转型具有正向决定作用。研究还揭示，政府效能在向可再生能源转型中发挥着建设性作用。此外，分析还证实了经济增长、工业增加值、城市化和外国直接投资在所选样本中对能源转型具有显著潜在作用。该研究分析为政策制定者制定能源转型政策及实现净零碳排放目标提供了实践意义。

articles.title_en: Risk network of global energy markets
articles.title_cn: 全球能源市场的风险网络
articles.abstract_en: This study evaluates extreme uncertainty connectedness among top global energy firms. The sample comprises of 68 firms from four energy-related subsectors (oil & gas, oil & gas related equipment and services, multiline utilities, and renewable energy). To provide an overview of tail connectedness, we construct a high-dimensional network between firms by utilizing a generalized error decomposition and a sparse vector autoregression framework with a latent common factor. Our empirical results indicate that between the four subsectors, the renewable energy subsector exhibits the highest uncertainty transmission to other underlying subsectors, primarily credited to an increased within-subsector idiosyncratic uncertainty before the COVID-19 crisis. After the burst of the COVID-19 pandemic, due to the higher connectedness, the role of the renewable energy companies in the spillover network is further intensified. The uncertainty connectedness demonstrates a time-varying trait. While the oil and gas subsector exhibits greater long-term linkages with the oil and gas related equipment and services subsector, the long-run dynamics exhibit a lower interconnectedness as compared to the short-run. Finally, there is an increased connectedness among companies operating in the same subsector with similar size, attributing to similarity and competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了全球顶级能源企业之间的极端不确定性连通性。样本包括来自四个能源相关子行业（石油与天然气、石油与天然气相关设备与服务、多线公用事业和可再生能源）的68家企业。为了提供尾部连通性的概览，我们利用广义误差分解和带有潜在共同因子的稀疏向量自回归框架，在企业之间构建了一个高维网络。我们的实证结果表明，在这四个子行业中，可再生能源子行业对其他基础子行业表现出最高的不确定性传导，这主要归因于COVID-19危机前子行业内部特异性不确定性的增加。在COVID-19大流行爆发后，由于连通性更高，可再生能源公司在溢出网络中的作用进一步增强。不确定性连通性表现出时变特征。虽然石油与天然气子行业与石油与天然气相关设备与服务子行业表现出更大的长期联系，但长期动态相比短期表现出较低的互联性。最后，在同一子行业中运营且规模相似的企业之间的连通性增加，这归因于相似性和竞争。

articles.title_en: On the performance of the United States nuclear power sector: A Bayesian approach
articles.title_cn: 美国核电行业绩效研究：一种贝叶斯方法
articles.abstract_en: Concerns over climate change and global emissions has again placed attention on clean energy sources. Nuclear power plants are one of many sources of clean energy and yet few studies have examined the structure of technology exclusively in this area. We utilize Bayesian empirical likelihood methods to estimate a stochastic frontier model to examine scale economies, technical efficiency and technological change in the United States nuclear energy generation sector. We find decreasing scale economies, a fact consistent with the recent decline of the industry. Our results suggest that small nuclear reactors may benefit the sector as a whole.
articles.abstract_cn: 对气候变化和全球排放的担忧再次将注意力集中在清洁能源来源上。核电站是众多清洁能源来源之一，但很少有研究专门考察该领域的技术结构。我们利用贝叶斯经验似然方法估计随机前沿模型，以考察美国核能发电行业的规模经济、技术效率和技术变化。我们发现规模经济递减，这一事实与行业近期的衰退相一致。我们的结果表明，小型核反应堆可能对整个行业有益。

articles.title_en: Social media and energy justice: A global evidence
articles.title_cn: 社交媒体与能源正义：全球证据
articles.abstract_en: Over the past decades, several advances have been made in the climate field because of human activities, economic situation, and shift in the recognition that the people suffer most from the adverse effects of climate change. According to COP27, it is now commonly acknowledged that the poorest countries—those that pollute the least—are those that experience the worst effects of climate change. This recognition raises the issue of justice in environmental matters: today we speak of environmental justice, which would consist of applying justice principles to energy policy, energy production and systems, energy consumption, and climate change. The objective of this study is to examine the cross-sectional impact of social media penetration, particularly Facebook, on energy justice in a panel of 70 countries. We build three sub-indicators of energy justice: distributive justice, procedural justice, and restorative justice. We use OLS, Oster (2019), Lewbel 2SLS (2012) and Kiviet (2020) instrumental variable techniques and the results show that Facebook penetration improves energy justice across countries. Precisely, Facebook penetration boosts distributive, procedural and restorative justice. Therefore, social media should be included to enhance low-carbon transitions awareness among the masses. Further, social media should be promoted to emphasize on social services equitability, climate-vulnerable economies to help civil awareness and energy resilience.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，由于人类活动、经济状况以及人们认识到最受气候变化不利影响的人群，气候领域取得了多项进展。根据COP27，现在普遍承认，最贫穷的国家——那些污染最少的国家——遭受气候变化最严重的影响。这种认识引发了环境事务中的正义问题：今天我们谈论环境正义，它将正义原则应用于能源政策、能源生产和系统、能源消费以及气候变化。本研究的目标是考察社交媒体渗透率（特别是Facebook）对能源正义的横截面影响，样本为70个国家。我们构建了能源正义的三个子指标：分配正义、程序正义和恢复正义。我们使用OLS、Oster（2019）、Lewbel 2SLS（2012）和Kiviet（2020）工具变量技术，结果表明Facebook渗透率提高了各国的能源正义。具体而言，Facebook渗透率促进了分配正义、程序正义和恢复正义。因此，应将社交媒体纳入以增强大众对低碳转型的认识。此外，应推广社交媒体，以强调社会服务的公平性，帮助气候脆弱经济体提高公民意识和能源韧性。

articles.title_en: Climate events matter in the global natural gas market
articles.title_cn: 气候事件在全球天然气市场中具有重要意义
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of 2404 global extreme climate events on natural gas abnormal returns (ARs) and identifies the driving factors of the impact. The findings show that 24.09% of the global extreme climate events have a significant impact on natural gas ARs, with the cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) reaching their peak on the eighth day after the event. There is heterogeneity in the patterns of the impacts of extreme climate events on CARs. Among them, the impacts of storms are strongest, the impacts of extreme temperatures have the longest duration, the responses of CARs to wildfires are the earliest, and the responses to floods with high damage and high-peak CARs have the largest differences in trends. In terms of the regions of extreme climate events, the responses of CARs are most rapid to events in the Americas, are strongest to events in Europe, and are most moderate to events in Asia. Compared with events occurring in non-major gas-producing countries, events occurring in major gas-producing countries have greater influences. We also find that the impact of extreme climate events on the natural gas market is deepening over time. Finally, the study finds that factors concerning fundamental, speculative, climatic, and event attributes have significant impacts on peak CARs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了2404起全球极端气候事件对天然气异常收益率（ARs）的影响，并识别了影响的驱动因素。研究发现，24.09%的全球极端气候事件对天然气异常收益率有显著影响，累计异常收益率（CARs）在事件后第八天达到峰值。极端气候事件对CARs的影响模式存在异质性。其中，风暴的影响最强，极端温度的影响持续时间最长，CARs对野火的响应最早，而对高损害和高峰值CARs的洪水的响应趋势差异最大。就极端气候事件的区域而言，CARs对美洲事件的响应最快，对欧洲事件的响应最强，对亚洲事件的响应最为温和。与非主要产气国发生的事件相比，主要产气国发生的事件影响更大。我们还发现，极端气候事件对天然气市场的影响随时间加深。最后，研究发现，基本面、投机、气候和事件属性方面的因素对峰值CARs有显著影响。

articles.title_en: Roadmapping green economic restructuring: A Ricardian gradient approach
articles.title_cn: 绿色经济重构路线图：一种李嘉图梯度方法
articles.abstract_en: This study presents a dynamic model for an optimal green restructuring of a national economy. The model aims to achieve an optimal increase in the gross domestic product (GDP), a decrease in energy consumption, and mitigation of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. It utilizes the environmentally- and energy-extended input-output model and Ricardian gradients (RGs) to handle the time-varying adjustment of the sectoral structure of the gross output (GO). The components of the RGs reveal the comparative advantage of the sectors of the economy with respect to the GDP to GO, energy to GO, or GHG to GO ratios, respectively. The trajectory of the structural change created by the model forms optimal acute angles with all RGs at each moment in time. This property makes the trajectory locally optimal. The objective of global optimization was to maximize the minimal improvement in all indicators at the final point. To achieve this goal, the model optimizes the trajectory parameters: the weight coefficients of the GDP, energy consumption, GHG emissions, and the speed of restructuring. A combination of local and global optimization enables the economic system to achieve short- and long-term economic and environmental goals together. Application of the model to the Chinese economy from 1995 to 2009 showed an increase in the GDP by 26.23%, along with a decrease in energy consumption by 28.95% and mitigation of GHG emissions by 33.78%.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一个国家经济最优绿色重构的动态模型。该模型旨在实现国内生产总值（GDP）的最优增长、能源消耗的减少以及温室气体（GHG）排放的减缓。它利用环境和能源扩展的投入产出模型以及李嘉图梯度（RGs）来处理总产出（GO）部门结构的时变调整。RGs的组成部分分别揭示了经济各部门在GDP与GO、能源与GO或GHG与GO比率方面的比较优势。模型产生的结构变化轨迹在每个时刻与所有RGs形成最优锐角。这一性质使得轨迹局部最优。全局优化的目标是在最终点最大化所有指标的最小改进。为实现这一目标，模型优化了轨迹参数：GDP、能源消耗、GHG排放的权重系数以及重构速度。局部和全局优化的结合使经济系统能够共同实现短期和长期的经济与环境目标。将该模型应用于1995年至2009年的中国经济，结果显示GDP增长了26.23%，能源消耗减少了28.95%，GHG排放减缓了33.78%。

articles.title_en: The asymmetric effects of oil price shocks on green innovation
articles.title_cn: 油价冲击对绿色创新的非对称影响
articles.abstract_en: Given the global resolve to transit away from traditional energy sources toward a low carbon economy, companies are under increasing pressure to grapple with the tension between long-term business sustainability and short-term energy threat. To assess how companies react to this intertemporal choice, we investigate whether and how green innovation, measured by green patent count and value, is affected by oil price shocks when the energy threat is most acute. Over an extended sample period from 1976 to 2018, we find that oil demand (supply) shock spurs (dampens) the intensity and economic value of green patenting activity. This evidence is attributable to energy efficiency improvement and environmental control. Further, firms with access to finance and those in highly competitive industries are most sensitive to oil price shocks. Finally, distinct from companies that rely on crude oil as energy inputs, oil producers curtail green innovation in wake of oil demand shocks, despite the increased profitability.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于全球决心从传统能源向低碳经济转型，企业面临着越来越大的压力，需要在长期业务可持续性与短期能源威胁之间权衡。为了评估企业如何应对这种跨期选择，我们研究了在能源威胁最为严重时，以绿色专利数量和价值衡量的绿色创新是否以及如何受到油价冲击的影响。在从1976年到2018年的扩展样本期内，我们发现石油需求（供给）冲击会刺激（抑制）绿色专利活动的强度和经济价值。这一证据归因于能源效率提升和环境控制。此外，能够获得融资的企业以及处于高度竞争行业的企业对油价冲击最为敏感。最后，与依赖原油作为能源投入的企业不同，石油生产商在石油需求冲击后削减了绿色创新，尽管盈利能力有所提高。

articles.title_en: A broader perspective on the inflationary effects of energy price shocks
articles.title_cn: 能源价格冲击通胀效应的更广阔视角
articles.abstract_en: Consumers purchase energy in many forms. Sometimes energy goods are consumed directly, for instance, in the form of gasoline used to operate a vehicle, electricity to light a home, or natural gas to heat a home. At other times, the cost of energy is embodied in the prices of goods and services that consumers buy, say when purchasing an airline ticket or when buying online garden furniture made from plastic to be delivered by mail. Previous research has focused on quantifying the pass-through of the price of crude oil or the price of motor gasoline to U.S. inflation. Neither approach accounts for the fact that percent changes in refined product prices need not be proportionate to the percent change in the price of oil, that not all energy is derived from oil, and that the correlation of price shocks across energy markets is far from one. This paper develops a vector autoregressive model that quantifies the joint impact of shocks to several energy prices on headline and core CPI inflation. Our analysis confirms that focusing on gasoline price shocks alone will underestimate the inflationary pressures emanating from the energy sector, but not enough to overturn the conclusion that much of the observed increase in headline inflation in 2021 and 2022 reflected non-energy price shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 消费者以多种形式购买能源。有时能源商品被直接消费，例如，以汽油形式用于驱动车辆，电力用于照明家庭，或天然气用于家庭供暖。其他时候，能源成本体现在消费者购买的商品和服务价格中，比如购买机票或在线购买由塑料制成并通过邮寄送达的花园家具时。以往研究侧重于量化原油价格或车用汽油价格向美国通胀的传导。这两种方法均未考虑到精炼产品价格的百分比变化不必与石油价格百分比变化成比例，并非所有能源都源自石油，且能源市场间价格冲击的相关性远非一。本文开发了一个向量自回归模型，量化多种能源价格冲击对总体和核心CPI通胀的联合影响。我们的分析证实，仅关注汽油价格冲击会低估来自能源部门的通胀压力，但不足以推翻以下结论：2021年和2022年观察到的总体通胀上升中，很大部分反映了非能源价格冲击。

articles.title_en: Renewable energy use and export performance of manufacturing firms: Panel evidence from six industries in India
articles.title_cn: 可再生能源使用与制造业企业出口绩效：来自印度六个行业的面板证据
articles.abstract_en: We measure renewable energy intensity and examine its impact on export performance of Indian manufacturing firms from six industries over the panel period 2011–2021. Contrary to the negative impact of renewable energy use on export performance in macroeconomic studies, our firm-level panel analysis suggests that the impact of renewable energy usage on export intensity could differ from industry to industry. We use both system dynamic panel estimation and fixed effects with Driscoll and Kraay standard errors to correct for cross-sectional dependence. Under both the methods, our results suggest to the positive impact of renewable energy usage on export intensity in most of the industries analysed. However, the magnitude of effect differs from industry to industry. This has heterogeneous implication for energy policy for different industries. Use of renewable energy especially in hard-to-abate sectors will need special attention by the governments and policymakers in India.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量了可再生能源强度，并考察了其对印度六个行业制造业企业在面板期2011-2021内出口绩效的影响。与宏观经济研究中可再生能源使用对出口绩效的负面影响相反，我们的企业层面面板分析表明，可再生能源使用对出口强度的影响可能因行业而异。我们同时使用系统动态面板估计和带有Driscoll和Kraay标准误的固定效应来修正横截面依赖。在两种方法下，我们的结果表明，在分析的大多数行业中，可再生能源使用对出口强度有正向影响。然而，影响的大小因行业而异。这对不同行业的能源政策具有异质性含义。特别是在难以减排的行业中使用可再生能源，将需要印度政府和政策制定者的特别关注。

articles.title_en: The effect of innovation pilot on carbon total factor productivity: Quasi-experimental evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 创新试点对碳全要素生产率的影响：来自中国的准实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Since the policy design for carbon emission reduction must consider both the efficiency and the cost of emission reduction, improvement in carbon total factor productivity (CTFP) is widely regarded as an important economic path in reducing carbon emissions. With prefecture-level data in China from 2003 to 2016, this paper explores the role of innovation pilot on the CTFP using China's Innovative City Pilot (ICP) policy as a quasi-experiment. First, we construct a novel CTFP framework, that combines the non-parametric Luenberger productivity indicator with the biennial non-radial directional distance function, to take the slack issues and infeasibility problem into consideration. Next, with the staggered difference-in-differences model, we examine whether innovation can stimulate CTFP improvement. The results show that the ICP policy exerts a significant positive effect on CTFP, increasing cities' CTFP by 0.015 on average. Moreover, we identify five potential channels from both economic analysis and comprehensive factor decomposition: technological and low-carbon innovation, industrial upgrading, energy efficiency, carbon emission intensity, and efficiency change. These positive impacts are heterogeneous across different kinds of cities. Specifically, the effects of innovation are stronger in the eastern and central cities, large cities, and cities with tighter environmental regulations. Meanwhile, the political incentives analysis shows that in cities with higher political incentives, officials perform better in energy intensity reduction and CTFP improvement. This paper explores direct evidence for the innovation's effect on carbon productivity, which provides a novel perspective for improving carbon productivity and the future direction of innovation in China.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于碳减排的政策设计必须同时考虑减排效率和减排成本，碳全要素生产率（CTFP）的提高被广泛认为是减少碳排放的重要经济路径。利用中国2003年至2016年的地级市数据，本文以中国创新型城市试点（ICP）政策为准实验，探讨创新试点对CTFP的作用。首先，我们构建了一个新颖的CTFP框架，将非参数Luenberger生产率指标与双年非径向方向性距离函数相结合，以考虑松弛问题和不可行性问题。其次，利用交错双重差分模型，我们检验创新是否能促进CTFP的提升。结果表明，ICP政策对CTFP产生了显著的积极影响，平均使城市CTFP提高了0.015。此外，我们从经济分析和综合因素分解中识别出五个潜在渠道：技术和低碳创新、产业升级、能源效率、碳排放强度以及效率变化。这些积极影响在不同类型的城市中存在异质性。具体而言，创新效应在东部和中部城市、大城市以及环境规制更严格的城市中更强。同时，政治激励分析表明，在政治激励较高的城市，官员在降低能源强度和提升CTFP方面表现更好。本文为创新对碳生产率的影响提供了直接证据，为提高碳生产率和中国未来的创新方向提供了新的视角。

articles.title_en: Oil price returns and firm's fixed investment: A production pattern
articles.title_cn: 油价回报与企业固定投资：一种生产模式
articles.abstract_en: This paper aims to enlarge the acquaintance with the influence of oil price returns on fixed investment of all Chinese non-financial listed companies. According to our empirical results, oil price returns have a statistically and economically significant and negative predictive power for firm's fixed investment. Other main findings can be summarized as follows: (i) this oil return effect is robust and consistent even considering oil shocks and its different sources; (ii) the heterogeneities of this effect across industries and industrial layers present a “production pattern”; (iii) a composite cost and the financing constraints theory reveal the heterogeneities across firms with varying financial constraints, investment irreversibility, and industry competition; (iv) a combination of changes in demand stimulation and cost pressures contributes to the asymmetric impacts of oil price returns, which vary throughout the oil prices distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在加深对油价回报对中国所有非金融上市公司固定投资影响的认识。根据我们的实证结果，油价回报对企业固定投资具有统计上和经济上显著且负向的预测能力。其他主要发现可总结如下：（i）即使考虑石油冲击及其不同来源，这种油价效应依然稳健且一致；（ii）该效应在行业和产业层级间的异质性呈现“生产模式”；（iii）综合成本与融资约束理论揭示了具有不同融资约束、投资不可逆性和行业竞争程度的企业间的异质性；（iv）需求刺激变化与成本压力的结合导致了油价回报的非对称影响，这些影响随油价分布而变化。

articles.title_en: Does financialization enhance renewable energy development in Sub-Saharan African countries?
articles.title_cn: 金融化是否促进了撒哈拉以南非洲国家的可再生能源发展？
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the influence of financial development, fiscal policy, and foreign capital on renewable energy development in 21 Sub-Saharan African nations from 2000 to 2021. The aim is to address the dearth of information on how the financial sector affects renewable energy. Using panel data and the Panel Quantile Autoregressive Distributed Lag (PQARDL) technique, we analyze the short- and long-term impacts of these factors while considering industrialization and institution quality. Our findings indicate that financial development and fiscal policy pose significant obstacles to renewable energy development across all quantile distributions in the long run. However, foreign capital positively contributes to renewable energy development across most quantiles, except the 70th quantile. We also observe a declining trend in Sub-Saharan Africa's share of renewable development due to industrialization and institutional quality in the long term. Furthermore, the interactive roles of fiscal policy and institutional quality hinder renewable advancement in the region over time. These empirical outcomes provide valuable insights on how to attract foreign capital and allocate investments in renewable development. By doing so, we can offer consumers cost-competitive choices and strive towards extending high-value-added facilities within a sustainable environment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了2000年至2021年间金融发展、财政政策和外国资本对21个撒哈拉以南非洲国家可再生能源发展的影响。目的是解决关于金融部门如何影响可再生能源的信息匮乏问题。利用面板数据和面板分位数自回归分布滞后（PQARDL）技术，我们在考虑工业化和制度质量的同时，分析了这些因素的短期和长期影响。我们的研究结果表明，从长期来看，金融发展和财政政策对所有分位数分布的可再生能源发展构成了显著障碍。然而，外国资本在大多数分位数上对可再生能源发展有积极贡献，但第70分位数除外。我们还观察到，由于工业化和制度质量，撒哈拉以南非洲在可再生能源发展中的份额在长期呈下降趋势。此外，财政政策和制度质量的交互作用在长期内阻碍了该地区可再生能源的进步。这些实证结果为如何吸引外国资本和分配可再生能源发展投资提供了有价值的见解。通过这样做，我们可以为消费者提供具有成本竞争力的选择，并努力在可持续环境中扩展高附加值设施。

articles.title_en: Disentangling the asymmetric effect of financialization on the green output gap
articles.title_cn: 金融化对绿色产出缺口的非对称效应解析
articles.abstract_en: Insufficient green output can lead to environmental degradation while overinvestment may result in economic imbalances, social inequalities, and opportunity costs. Thus, sustaining an optimal level of green growth could restrict both green neglect and green grabbing. A higher level of financialization is believed to be an efficient allocation mechanism for green development. This research provides empirical insights into how financialization helps narrow the green growth gap. Using various estimation techniques such as the Hodrick-Prescott (HP) filter, Hamilton's filter, and the super-efficiency slack-based model, we examine the heterogeneous effects of financialization on the green growth gap by utilizing unbalanced panel data from 124 countries spanning the period 1980–2020. The results, obtained through bootstrapped quantile regression, indicate that financial access, depth, and efficiency contribute to improving insufficient green growth levels and curbing excessive investment in green initiatives. However, we find little or no evidence that financial stability or liberalization restricts overinvestment in low-carbon economic development or improves environmental stewardship when green neglect is observed. Additional analysis suggests that business cycle fluctuations, especially during recessionary periods, adversely affect the ability of financialization to optimally allocate green resources, but this effect is mitigated if financial development is countercyclical. Policymakers should prioritize promoting financial depth and efficiency, as well as provide access to finance, in order to support sustainable green growth and to avoid overinvestment in low-carbon economic development.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色产出不足可能导致环境退化，而过度投资则可能引发经济失衡、社会不平等和机会成本。因此，维持最优的绿色增长水平可以同时限制绿色忽视和绿色攫取。更高水平的金融化被认为是绿色发展的有效配置机制。本研究提供了关于金融化如何帮助缩小绿色增长缺口的实证见解。利用多种估计技术，如霍德里克-普雷斯科特（HP）滤波器、汉密尔顿滤波器和超效率松弛变量模型，我们利用124个国家在1980-2020年期间的非平衡面板数据，考察了金融化对绿色增长缺口的异质性影响。通过自助分位数回归获得的结果表明，金融准入、金融深度和金融效率有助于改善绿色增长不足的水平，并抑制对绿色倡议的过度投资。然而，我们发现很少或没有证据表明金融稳定性或金融自由化能限制低碳经济发展的过度投资，或在观察到绿色忽视时改善环境管理。进一步分析表明，商业周期波动，尤其是在衰退时期，会对金融化优化配置绿色资源的能力产生不利影响，但如果金融发展具有逆周期性，这种影响会得到缓解。政策制定者应优先促进金融深度和效率，并提供金融准入，以支持可持续的绿色增长，避免对低碳经济发展的过度投资。

articles.title_en: Let’s talk about risk! Stock market effects of risk disclosure for European energy utilities
articles.title_cn: 让我们谈谈风险！欧洲能源公用事业公司风险披露的股票市场效应
articles.abstract_en: We analyze how risk reporting by European energy utilities is related to uncertainty about firms’ future prospects. Using an unsupervised machine learning topic model, we classify the content of the risk reports presented in the notes to the financial statements into different risk topics over the period from 2007 to 2017. We find that more risk reporting is related to lower idiosyncratic volatility and that this relation is especially evident for reporting about credit risk, risk management processes, economic risk, and accounting-related risk. We also find that the uncertainty-decreasing effect of risk disclosure extends to a positive relation between risk disclosure and firm value. Our study contributes to the call for more transparency in risk reporting and disclosure. Interestingly, we are unable to identify a climate-related risk topic, and further tests show only a rudimentary disclosure of climate-related risks. Combining the usefulness of the current risk disclosure regulation with the current lack of climate-related risk disclosures, we see good reasons for increased mandatory climate-related risk disclosures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了欧洲能源公用事业公司的风险报告如何与公司未来前景的不确定性相关。使用无监督机器学习主题模型，我们将2007年至2017年期间财务报表附注中呈现的风险报告内容分类为不同的风险主题。我们发现，更多的风险报告与较低的 idiosyncratic 波动性相关，并且这种关系在信用风险、风险管理流程、经济风险和会计相关风险的报告中尤为明显。我们还发现，风险披露的不确定性降低效应延伸至风险披露与公司价值之间的正相关关系。我们的研究有助于呼吁提高风险报告和披露的透明度。有趣的是，我们无法识别出气候相关的风险主题，进一步的测试显示气候相关风险的披露仅处于初步阶段。结合当前风险披露法规的有用性与当前气候相关风险披露的缺乏，我们认为有充分理由增加强制性的气候相关风险披露。

articles.title_en: Carbon emission reduction analysis for cloud computing industry: Can carbon emissions trading and technology innovation help?
articles.title_cn: 云计算行业碳减排分析：碳排放交易和技术创新能否有所帮助？
articles.abstract_en: The emerging cloud computing industry (CCI) has become an important source of carbon emissions; therefore, choosing an appropriate carbon emission reduction strategy is of key importance. Based on two important alternative carbon reduction strategies, namely carbon emissions trading (CET) and emission reduction technological innovation (ERTI), in this paper, a scenario-based simulation model of carbon emission reduction strategies is established for the CCI of China. Based on different derivative scenarios of CET and ERTI strategies, 22 carbon reduction strategy scenarios are designed and subjected to simulation analysis. Then, a slacks-based model that considers undesirable output is constructed and used to evaluate the comprehensive effect of proposed carbon reduction strategy scenarios. Based on the evaluation results of the strategy scenarios, a tolerant CET strategy scenario with a high free quota ratio and a low carbon trading price has the potential to reverse the increasing trend of carbon emissions. This tolerant strategy scenario can also achieve a more efficient carbon emission reduction result for the CCI in the long run. In terms of technology innovation, the strong promotion of installed zero‑carbon capacity and negative emission technology applications can effectively promote the reduction of carbon emissions. The results of this analysis show that the carbon emission reduction strategy with tolerant CET and strong ERTI will contribute to the healthy development of the CCI.
articles.abstract_cn: 新兴的云计算行业（CCI）已成为碳排放的重要来源；因此，选择合适的碳减排策略至关重要。基于两种重要的替代性碳减排策略，即碳排放交易（CET）和减排技术创新（ERTI），本文为中国CCI建立了一个基于情景的碳减排策略模拟模型。基于CET和ERTI策略的不同衍生情景，设计了22个碳减排策略情景并进行了模拟分析。然后，构建了一个考虑非期望产出的松弛变量模型，用于评估所提出的碳减排策略情景的综合效果。基于策略情景的评估结果，具有高免费配额比例和低碳交易价格的宽松CET策略情景有可能逆转碳排放的增长趋势。从长期来看，这种宽松的策略情景还能为CCI实现更高效的碳减排效果。在技术创新方面，大力推广安装零碳容量和负排放技术应用可以有效促进碳减排。分析结果表明，宽松的CET和强力的ERTI相结合的碳减排策略将有助于CCI的健康发展。

articles.title_en: The impact of environmental regulation on productivity with co-production of goods and bads
articles.title_cn: 环境规制对商品与坏产出共同生产下生产率的影响
articles.abstract_en: Governments have implemented various environmental regulation policies to improve environmental performance by reducing undesirable economic outcomes. These policies may shock productivity as they change the input allocation, economic outputs, and pollutant emissions. One widely ignored fact in related literature is that goods and bads are co-produced, in which the latter is jointly generated as the byproduct. However, ignoring the co-production of goods and bads may bias the estimation, especially tend to conclude that environmental regulation and productivity are inversely related. In this paper, by incorporating the co-production of goods and bads into the empirical framework to measure productivity, we estimate the productivity shocks from environmental regulation, especially explore how these shocks take place. Using an exogenous instrumental variable to overcome endogeneity, we found that a country increasing environmental regulation from 25th to 50th quantiles improves its productivity by 28%, yet the magnitude of the effect would be 44% by catching up with the technology frontiers worldwide. The results suggest that environmental regulation improves productivity but depresses technology progress. Using innovation data, we provide further evidence of the finding. Furthermore, productivity shocks from market-based measures are estimated to be more substantial than those from non-market-based measures. We anticipate this paper to provide empirical evidence for a better understanding of the economic implications associated with policy interventions in the context of sustainable development.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府实施了各种环境规制政策，通过减少不良经济产出来改善环境绩效。这些政策可能因改变投入分配、经济产出和污染物排放而对生产率产生冲击。相关文献中一个被广泛忽视的事实是，商品和坏产出是共同生产的，其中后者作为副产品联合产生。然而，忽视商品和坏产出的共同生产可能会使估计产生偏差，尤其是倾向于得出环境规制与生产率呈负相关的结论。在本文中，通过将商品和坏产出的共同生产纳入实证框架来衡量生产率，我们估计了环境规制带来的生产率冲击，特别是探讨了这些冲击是如何发生的。利用外生工具变量克服内生性，我们发现，一个国家将环境规制从第25个百分位提高到第50个百分位，其生产率提高了28%，而通过追赶全球技术前沿，这一效应的幅度将达到44%。结果表明，环境规制提高了生产率，但抑制了技术进步。利用创新数据，我们为这一发现提供了进一步的证据。此外，基于市场措施的规制带来的生产率冲击估计比非市场措施更为显著。我们期望本文能为更好地理解可持续发展背景下政策干预的经济影响提供实证证据。

articles.title_en: Will informal environmental regulation induce residents to form a green lifestyle? Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 非正式环境规制会诱导居民形成绿色生活方式吗？来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Promoting green transition in social life and consumption is an effective way to achieve the goal of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality”. The current academic community has paid extensive attention to the green way of production while not paying enough attention to the green transition of lifestyles. The relevant empirical studies on the theme of green lifestyles are rare. Based on the annual panel data of 30 provinces in China from 2008 to 2019, this study investigates the nexus between informal environmental regulation (IER) and residents' green lifestyles. It has been found that IER can directly influence the formation of green lifestyles. It can also positively influence residents' green lifestyles by raising public environmental awareness. At the same time, the regional green technology innovation level positively modifies the influence of IER on green lifestyles. In addition, this paper also examines the impact of environmental regulation on people's green level of lifestyle under different income levels. Through the dominance analysis, it is also found that IER has a more significant impact on the formation of residents' green lifestyles than formal environmental regulation. This study attempts to open the “black box” of IER to guide residents to form a green lifestyle while providing a reference for the government to guide residents to form a green lifestyle and policy formulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 推动社会生活与消费的绿色转型是实现“碳达峰与碳中和”目标的有效途径。当前学术界对绿色生产方式给予了广泛关注，但对生活方式的绿色转型关注不足。关于绿色生活方式主题的相关实证研究较为罕见。基于2008年至2019年中国30个省份的年度面板数据，本研究探讨了非正式环境规制（IER）与居民绿色生活方式之间的关系。研究发现，非正式环境规制能够直接影响绿色生活方式的形成。它还可以通过提高公众环境意识来积极影响居民的绿色生活方式。同时，区域绿色技术创新水平正向调节了非正式环境规制对绿色生活方式的影响。此外，本文还考察了不同收入水平下环境规制对人们生活方式绿色程度的影响。通过优势分析，还发现非正式环境规制对居民绿色生活方式形成的影响比正式环境规制更为显著。本研究试图打开非正式环境规制的“黑箱”，以引导居民形成绿色生活方式，同时为政府引导居民形成绿色生活方式及政策制定提供参考。

articles.title_en: What drives the temporal dynamics and spatial differences of urban and rural household emissions in China?
articles.title_cn: 什么驱动了中国城乡家庭排放的时间动态和空间差异？
articles.abstract_en: Temporal dynamics and spatial differences of urban and rural household CO2 emissions are worth exploring in the face of climate change. This study combines decomposition analysis models and Dagum's Gini coefficient method to explore household emission characteristics and key drivers of 30 provinces in China. Income is still the major factor driving the growth of household emissions. Urbanization is accompanied by a population shift from rural areas to urban areas. Population has a positive effect on urban household emissions and a negative effect on rural household emissions. Although the rural population gradually decreases, their increasing income level and propensity to consume lead to emissions that are not negligible. Household CO2 emissions have significant spatial differences. For urban households in the eastern coastal region and rural households in the northern region, the population size effect drives the growth of household emissions. Rational population mobility is beneficial to reduce intra-regional differences in household emissions. Propensity to consume and emission intensity are important factors driving household emission growth in underdeveloped provinces and resource-based provinces, respectively. Thus improving household green awareness and promoting consumption upgrades are urgent. To enhance the coordination of regional development, cross-regional flows of technology and capital will help reduce regional emission disparities.
articles.abstract_cn: 在气候变化背景下，城乡家庭二氧化碳排放的时间动态和空间差异值得探讨。本研究结合分解分析模型和达古姆基尼系数方法，探讨了中国30个省份的家庭排放特征和关键驱动因素。收入仍是推动家庭排放增长的主要因素。城市化伴随着人口从农村向城市转移。人口对城市家庭排放有正向影响，对农村家庭排放有负向影响。尽管农村人口逐渐减少，但其收入水平和消费倾向的提高导致排放不可忽视。家庭二氧化碳排放存在显著的空间差异。对于东部沿海地区的城市家庭和北部地区的农村家庭，人口规模效应推动了家庭排放的增长。合理的人口流动有利于减少家庭排放的区域内部差异。消费倾向和排放强度分别是推动欠发达省份和资源型省份家庭排放增长的重要因素。因此，提高家庭绿色意识和促进消费升级迫在眉睫。为增强区域发展的协调性，技术和资本的跨区域流动将有助于缩小区域排放差异。

articles.title_en: Oil price uncertainty and audit fees: Evidence from the energy industry
articles.title_cn: 油价不确定性与审计费用：来自能源行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study examines how oil price uncertainty, measured by implied volatility, affects audit fees. Using samples from the energy industry, we find that oil price uncertainty increases audit fees. Furthermore, the mechanism analyses demonstrate that the increase in audit fees is driven by the increased audit effort rather than a higher audit risk premium. Additionally, the positive impact of oil price uncertainty on audit fees is more pronounced for non-state-owned firms, firms with weaker corporate governance, and firms with greater earnings manipulation risks. Finally, our main finding remains robust for oil price uncertainty measured by Shanghai Crude Oil Futures and West Texas Intermediate.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了以隐含波动率衡量的油价不确定性如何影响审计费用。利用能源行业的样本，我们发现油价不确定性增加了审计费用。此外，机制分析表明，审计费用的增加是由审计努力的增加而非更高的审计风险溢价所驱动。另外，油价不确定性对审计费用的正向影响在非国有企业、公司治理较弱的企业以及盈余操纵风险较大的企业中更为显著。最后，我们的主要发现在以上海原油期货和西德克萨斯中质原油衡量的油价不确定性下依然稳健。

articles.title_en: Forward-looking dynamic network charges for real-world electricity systems: A Slovenian case study
articles.title_cn: 面向实际电力系统的前瞻性动态网络收费：斯洛文尼亚案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Electricity network charges are intended to recover network costs and adhere to economic efficiency and equity principles. Most network charges currently applied in real-world systems are merely focused on cost recovery, implicitly assuming inelastic customers. Although proposals for improved network tariff designs can be found in the literature, they are tested only for simplified small feeders. This paper reformulates a dynamic network tariff to implement it in a real-world electricity system. By adapting the proposed improved network tariff designs to manage large-scale layered networks and complex data sets, we address this gap in the literature. First, when considering the entire network, consumers and generators need to be clustered into subsystems by voltage levels, enabling to calculate the network utilization levels; this is the so-called cascade model. After, per voltage level, the network tariff needs to be computed. We focus on an advanced network tariff design that consists of forward-looking peak-coincident energy charges, which is symmetric for injections and withdrawals, a per-kWh component for energy losses, and fixed residual network charges. We illustrate that this network tariff incentivizes the shifting of flexible loads to off-peak hours and aligns individual customer incentives with expected system benefits, reducing future network investments. In addition, the symmetric nature of the proposed tariff enables a level playing field for distributed resources providing flexibility services. As demonstrated for Slovenia, the proposed formulation should be considered by regulators for implementation in real-world electricity systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 电力网络收费旨在回收网络成本，并遵循经济效率和公平原则。目前实际系统中应用的大多数网络收费仅侧重于成本回收，隐含假设用户无弹性。尽管文献中提出了改进网络电价设计的建议，但仅在简化的小型馈线上进行了测试。本文重新制定了一种动态网络电价，以在实际电力系统中实施。通过调整所提出的改进网络电价设计以管理大规模分层网络和复杂数据集，我们填补了文献中的这一空白。首先，在考虑整个网络时，需要将消费者和发电机按电压等级聚类到子系统中，从而能够计算网络利用水平；这就是所谓的级联模型。然后，在每个电压等级上，需要计算网络电价。我们专注于一种先进的网络电价设计，包括前瞻性的峰值重合能量收费，该收费对注入和提取是对称的，每千瓦时组件用于能量损耗，以及固定的剩余网络收费。我们证明，这种网络电价激励将灵活负荷转移到非高峰时段，并使个体客户激励与预期系统效益保持一致，减少未来网络投资。此外，所提出电价的对称性为提供灵活性服务的分布式资源创造了公平的竞争环境。正如在斯洛文尼亚所证明的，监管机构应考虑在实际电力系统中实施所提出的方案。

articles.title_en: The role of technical change in low-carbon transformation and crises in the electricity market: A CGE analysis with R&D investment
articles.title_cn: 技术变革在电力市场低碳转型与危机中的作用：基于研发投入的CGE分析
articles.abstract_en: The Russia–Ukraine conflict has exacerbated the global energy and electricity crisis. Considering China's carbon neutrality target, predicting the power market's response to the mandate of energy transformation and the impact of the energy crisis is particularly critical. Technical change is essential for the power sector to solve these crises; however, limited studies have systematically evaluated the role of endogenous technical change in low-carbon transformation of the power sector from an economy-wide perspective. Therefore, applying a multi-sector computable general equilibrium model, this study examines the potential trajectory of research and development (R&D)-based endogenous technical change, investigating the impact of different technical changes on China's power sector, the overall socio-economy, and the energy environment. The relevant results are threefold. First, carbon pricing combined with subsidising renewable electricity is an effective way to reduce emissions to achieve low-carbon transformation in the power sector. This approach can cause relatively moderate losses for the macro-economy and households' welfare. It can also significantly improve the renewable share, electrification rate and synergistic abatement effects on sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxides. Second, shifting R&D inputs from fossil fuel power generation technology to renewable power technologies should be considered to advance the deep decarbonisation of the power sector. This approach can further improve the renewable share and electrification rate and enhance synergistic abatement effects; however, it can also slightly increase the macro-economic loss. Third, to alleviate the negative impacts to the macro-economy, it is advisable to consider increasing the R&D inputs of various sectors extensively, rather than only increasing that in the power sector. This approach can effectively alleviate the negative impacts on the socio-economy while improving the renewable share with the best synergistic abatement effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 俄乌冲突加剧了全球能源和电力危机。考虑到中国的碳中和目标，预测电力市场对能源转型任务和能源危机影响的反应尤为关键。技术变革对于电力部门解决这些危机至关重要；然而，从经济全局视角系统评估内生技术变革在电力部门低碳转型中作用的研究仍然有限。因此，本研究应用多部门可计算一般均衡模型，考察基于研发（R&D）的内生技术变革的潜在路径，探究不同技术变革对中国电力部门、整体社会经济以及能源环境的影响。相关结果有三方面。第一，碳定价与补贴可再生电力相结合是实现电力部门低碳转型减排的有效途径。这种方法对宏观经济和家庭福利造成的损失相对温和，同时能显著提高可再生能源占比、电气化率以及对二氧化硫和氮氧化物的协同减排效果。第二，应考虑将研发投入从化石燃料发电技术转向可再生电力技术，以推进电力部门的深度脱碳。这种方法能进一步提高可再生能源占比和电气化率，增强协同减排效果；然而，也可能略微增加宏观经济损失。第三，为缓解对宏观经济的负面影响，建议考虑广泛增加各部门的研发投入，而非仅增加电力部门的研发投入。这种方法能有效缓解对社会经济的负面影响，同时提高可再生能源占比并实现最佳的协同减排效果。
